Cancer & Tissue Types: 14 histologies (breast, NSCLC/lung, glioblastoma, HCC, colorectal, melanoma, oral SCC, pancreatic, urothelial, type I diabetes pancreas, organoids)
Model Architecture: Family of hyperconvolutional foundation models (ImmuVisConv [ConvNeXt v2], ImmuVisSwin [Swin Transformer], ImmuVisViT [ViT]). Uses learned marker-kernel lookup tables; heteroscedastic loss for calibrated uncertainty.
Workflow & Preprocessing Assumptions: Denoising via Butterworth low-pass filter; min-99th percentile panel-wise scaling. Learns marker embeddings directly from IMC (no PLM needed).
Fit to CODEX / IMC / MIBI: Specialized for IMC (IMC-only in current release; out-performed VirTues/Eva on IMC). Does not yet support CODEX/MIBI.

Train Data / Corpus: IMC-only corpus (14 cohorts) AND Extended Multi-Tech corpus (32 cohorts across 4 technologies)
Dataset Size: IMC-only: 8,887 images, 146 markers. Multi-tech: 14.3K tissues, 239 markers, >5,100 patients
Cancer & Tissue Types: 17 tissue origins / 8 organ sites (breast, lung, colon, kidney, head & neck, melanoma, pancreas, endometrium, cutaneous lymphoma)
Model Architecture: Masked Autoencoder (MAE) with factorized spatial and marker attention. Integrates Protein Language Model (ESM-2) embeddings for marker identities; hierarchical summary tokens (cell, niche, tissue).
Workflow & Preprocessing Assumptions: Arcsinh(x/5) normalization, Gaussian blur (3x3), per-marker z-score standardization on cell masks. Fuses PLM embeddings with image tokens.
Fit to CODEX / IMC / MIBI: Supports IMC, CODEX, MIBI, and Orion (Multi-tech version). Demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer across technologies.

Train Data / Corpus: SPM-47M (30 cohorts across 8 fluorescence imaging platforms)
Dataset Size: >47 million single-marker image patches; 175 protein markers
Cancer & Tissue Types: 16 tissue types (breast, lung, colorectal, lymphoma [cHL, DLBCL], cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, renal cell carcinoma, prostate, gastric, etc.)
Tumor Samples / Subjects: 30 cohorts (56% public, 44% proprietary); thousands of tissue cores
Model Architecture: Vision Transformer (ViT-Small) trained with DINOv2 self-supervised learning framework. Fixed/sinusoidal marker positional encodings.
Workflow & Preprocessing Assumptions: Segmentation-free patch-level processing. Excludes ion-based modalities during pretraining.
Fit to CODEX / IMC / MIBI: Fits CODEX & 7 other fluorescence platforms (COMET, Vectra, IBEX, Orion, etc.). DOES NOT fit IMC/MIBI (training diverges due to ion noise).

Train Data / Corpus: Enable Medicine Platform multiplexed imaging corpus & validation cohorts
Dataset Size: >4,000 tissue regions, 64M cells, ~200 protein markers (Validation: >8,000 regions, 50M cells)
Cancer & Tissue Types: 9+ cancer types (head & neck, colorectal, gastric, liver, lung, breast, prostate, GIST, etc.)
Tumor Samples / Subjects: >4,159 pre-training regions + >8,000 validation regions across multiple cohorts
Model Architecture: Two-stage hierarchical Transformer (Channel-level Transformer Encoder for cross-channel correlations + Patch-level Vision Transformer for spatial domains). Masked image reconstruction.
Workflow & Preprocessing Assumptions: Multi-scale hierarchical encoding. Predicts between multiplex immunofluorescence (MIF) and routine H&E histology.
Fit to CODEX / IMC / MIBI: Pretrained and benchmarked primarily on CODEX/PhenoCycler. Limited validation and lower performance on IMC/MIBI.
